description: Current DAMO market state of one symbol across 10 timeframes: state name and permanent code per timeframe, plus a 10-value vector in fixed timeframe order.

format.description: compact = symbol, layer, time, vector, short citation and remaining quota only. full = per-timeframe state, seq, hash and engine version (for citing and checking).

layer.description: verified = closed candles (recorded, never changed); live = forming candles (provisional)

proof.description: Also put DAMO's Ed25519 signature in the result body as 'proof'.

symbol.description: Symbol, e.g. BTCUSDT (Binance USDⓈ-M perpetual naming)

timeframes.description: Optional. Only these timeframes are returned and counted against the quota (case-sensitive: 1m = minute, 1M = month). Omit for all 10.

name: get_market_state

as_of.description: verified: when DAMO last wrote this record (UTC). Each timeframe's own close time is states[tf].candle_close

observed_at.description: live: when DAMO observed the forming candles (UTC)

states.description: full format: per-timeframe state, code, candle status and record fields

vector.description: State codes in timeframe order (1 bull_momentum, 2 weakening, 3 bear_momentum, 4 recovery); null = not requested or not available

title: Get DAMO market state
